selected_priority: Compile top APPLY_NOW/APPLY_NEXT queue items into idempotent tracked recruiter packets with deduplication while preserving the manual submission boundary.
displaced_capability: The merged application execution queue could rank openings but stopped before converting winners into tracked recruiter-ready strategy packets. Re-running strategy compilation also lacked a batch-level deduplication contract, risking repeated lifecycle work and duplicate orchestration noise.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: Reuse the existing ApplicationStore, deterministic strategy application ids, queue ranking, and ManualApplicationAdapter rather than inventing a parallel batch lifecycle.
Create a new bulk packet generator independent of the current lifecycle. This would be simpler internally but would duplicate projection semantics and weaken application-state continuity.

Use the existing queue as the prioritization plane, pre-project deterministic application ids for idempotency, compile actionable lanes through the existing company/requirement-aware lifecycle, reuse complete packets, and repair incomplete packet state without performing submission.
